title: Fix the order facts
prompt: This function should turn each order's status and channel into rows of `field` and `value`. But every channel row shows the status, and the result has one struct column instead of two. Fix `solve(orders)`.
rules: Each order gives two rows: `field` `status` with the order's `status` as `value`, and `field` `channel` with its `channel`.
A missing status or channel still gives its row, with a missing `value`.
hints: Run the starter and compare the `channel` rows with the orders' channels.
Each struct in the array has its own `value` expression. Check which column each one reads.
After exploding, `"fact.*"` spreads the struct's fields into their own columns.
explanation: Two bugs. The second struct was copied from the first and still reads `F.col("status")`; it should read `F.col("channel")`. And the last `select` keeps `fact` as one struct column; `select("order_id", "fact.*")` spreads it into `field` and `value`. With both fixed, each order explodes into one status row and one channel row. A missing value doesn't drop a row, because the array always has two structs; only the `value` inside is missing.
